description:
Amazon Berkeley Objects GLB
	


The 7,953 3D models of Amazon Berkeley Objects
(ABO), made small enough to load in a browser. Each product is one .glb with its full PBR material (colour, normal,
metallic and roughness maps), at real size in metres, Y up. Most stand on Y = 0.
